expressions.name: GoldDataPath
expressions.description: Absolute path to one immutable Gold build powerbi export folder. Configure locally; never commit a developer-specific path.

expressions.name: GoldBuildPath
expressions.expression: let Root = if Text.Trim(GoldDataPath) = "" then error "Set GoldDataPath to the selected Gold build powerbi folder." else GoldDataPath, Parts = Text.Split(Text.TrimEnd(Text.Replace(Root, "\", "/"), "/"), "/") in Text.Combine(List.RemoveLastN(Parts, 1), "/")

expressions.name: GoldCsv
expressions.expression:
(fileName as text, expectedColumns as list, columnTypes as list) as table =>
let
    Root = if Text.Trim(GoldDataPath) = "" then error "Set GoldDataPath to the selected Gold build powerbi folder before refreshing." else Text.TrimEnd(GoldDataPath, {"\", "/"}),
    Raw = Csv.Document(File.Contents(Root & "/" & fileName), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Raw, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    Contract = Table.SelectColumns(Headers, expectedColumns, MissingField.Error),
    Nulls = Table.ReplaceValue(Contract, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Contract)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Nulls, columnTypes, "en-US")
in Typed

measures.name: Portfolio Insight
measures.expression:
VAR Ranked = FILTER(ALLSELECTED('Dim Country'[Country]), NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Total Balance])))
VAR Leaders = TOPN(1, Ranked, [Total Balance], DESC)
VAR Names = CONCATENATEX(Leaders, 'Dim Country'[Country], ", ", 'Dim Country'[Country], ASC)
RETURN IF([Total Customers] = 0, "No customers match the current selection.",
    IF(ISBLANK([Total Balance]), "Balances are unavailable for this selection.",
    "Largest observed balance: " & Names & ". Premium: " & FORMAT([Premium Customer %], "0.0%") &
    ". Balance coverage: " & FORMAT([Balance Coverage %], "0.0%") & ". Value is an analytical proxy."))
measures.description: Dynamic selected-country leader, honest missingness and actual premium/coverage figures. Tied leaders are all named.

measures.name: Balance Concentration Share
measures.expression:
VAR Fraction = SELECTEDVALUE('Balance Concentration'[Requested Fraction])
VAR Observed = FILTER(ALLSELECTED('Fact Customer Financials'), NOT ISBLANK('Fact Customer Financials'[Balance]))
VAR N = COUNTROWS(Observed)
VAR K = IF(Fraction = 0.5, ROUNDDOWN(N * Fraction, 0), ROUNDUP(N * Fraction, 0))
VAR Ranked = TOPN(K, Observed, IF(Fraction = 0.5, -'Fact Customer Financials'[Balance], 'Fact Customer Financials'[Balance]), DESC,
    IF(Fraction = 0.5, -'Fact Customer Financials'[Customer Key], 'Fact Customer Financials'[Customer Key]), ASC)
VAR TotalObserved = SUMX(Observed, 'Fact Customer Financials'[Balance])
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Fraction) && N > 0 && MINX(Observed, 'Fact Customer Financials'[Balance]) >= 0 && TotalObserved > 0,
    DIVIDE(COALESCE(SUMX(Ranked, 'Fact Customer Financials'[Balance]), 0), TotalObserved))
measures.description: Dynamic top ceil(1/5/10%) and bottom floor(50%) of observed balances. Negative/nonpositive cohorts return blank. No missing-zero imputation.
